results.description:
The addictive new novel from bestselling author and TikTok sensation, Tillie Cole.

Florida show jumper Hallie Oakley was raised in the saddle. After dominating the junior leagues, she’s stepping into the spotlight as one of the sport’s most exciting new talents.

Now, with her sights set on making her mark at the highest level, Hallie must train at the most prestigious equestrian facility in the world.

Nestled in the English countryside, Golden Oaks might look like nothing more than a beautiful stables, but it has produced some of the sport’s greatest riders. . . including Hallie’s idol, Jasper Knighton.

The brooding oldest son in a show jumping dynasty, Jasper has recently inherited Golden Oaks and is determined to defend its legacy.

From the moment Jasper and Hallie meet, their attraction is instant and mutual.

But when a shocking event threatens to tear Golden Oaks apart, Jasper knows he’ll do whatever it takes to protect what matters most to him.

Because losing Golden Oaks would be devastating – but losing Hallie is something Jasper refuses to risk.
